arxiv-1510-05994.title: Adapting a Fourier pseudospectral method to Dirichlet boundary conditions for Rayleigh–Bénard convection Volume: 7
arxiv-1510-05994.creator: I. C. Ramos, [ inst1 ] C. B. Briozzo [ inst1 ]
arxiv-1510-05994.description: Abstract \articlenumber 070015 \journalyear 2015 \editor C. A. Condat, G. J. Sibona 070015 \pipabstract We present the adaptation to non–free boundary conditions of a pseudospectral method based on the (complex) Fourier transform. The method is applied to the numerical integration of the Oberbeck–Boussinesq equations in a Rayleigh–Bénard cell with no-slip boundary conditions for velocity and Dirichlet boundary conditions for temperature.

arxiv-2111-06018.title: Quantifying the Atomistic Free-volume Morphology of Materials with Graph Theory
arxiv-2111-06018.creator: James Chapman, Nir Goldman
arxiv-2111-06018.description: Abstract We introduce a new computational methodology for the identification and characterization of free volume within/around atomistic configurations. This scheme employs a three-stage workflow, by which spheres are iteratively grown inside of voxels, and ultimately converted to planar graphs, which are then characterized via a graph-based order parameter.

arxiv-2208-11334.title: Next-Year Bankruptcy Prediction from Textual Data: Benchmark and Baselines
arxiv-2208-11334.creator: Henri Arno, Klaas Mulier, Joke Baeck, Thomas Demeester
arxiv-2208-11334.description: Abstract Models for bankruptcy prediction are useful in several real-world scenarios, and multiple research contributions have been devoted to the task, based on structured (numerical) as well as unstructured (textual) data. However, the lack of a common benchmark dataset and evaluation strategy impedes the objective comparison between models.

arxiv-2309-03993.title: Cold Solar Flares I. Microwave Domain Facilities: Nobeyama Radio Observatory (NoRP and NoRH), RSTN, SDO/AIA
arxiv-2309-03993.creator: Alexandra L. Lysenko, Stephen M. White, Dmitry A. Zhdanov, Nataliia S. Meshalkina, Aleksander T. Altyntsev, Galina G. Motorina, Gregory D. Fleishman
arxiv-2309-03993.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alexandra L. Lysenko, Stephen M. White, Dmitry A. Zhdanov, Nataliia S. Meshalkina, Aleksander T. Altyntsev, Galina G. Motorina, Gregory D. Fleishman. We identify a set of ∼ \sim 100 “cold” solar flares and perform a statistical analysis of them in the microwave range. Cold flares are characterized by a weak thermal response relative to nonthermal emission. This work is a follow up of a previous statistical study of cold flares, which focused on hard X-ray emission to quantify the flare nonthermal component.

arxiv-2410-12882.title: CitySolution: A complaining task distributive mobile application for smart city corporation using deep learning Journal: SoftwareX
arxiv-2410-12882.creator: Farhatun Shama, Abdul Aziz, Lamisa Bintee Mizan Deya
arxiv-2410-12882.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Farhatun Shama, Abdul Aziz, Lamisa Bintee Mizan Deya. The lack of an automated online platform for reporting citizens’ complaints, coupled with the city corporations’ struggles in managing them, presents significant challenges. Furthermore, the availability of resources is very limited to higher authorities for monitoring progress. The primary objective of this paper is to develop two Android applications and to categorize complaints automatically using a deep learning model created on the Teachable Machine.

arxiv-2501-03106.title: Cavity quantum electrodynamics of photonic temporal crystals
arxiv-2501-03106.creator: Junhyeon Bae, Kyungmin Lee, Bumki Min, Kun Woo Kim
arxiv-2501-03106.description: Abstract Photonic temporal crystals host a variety of intriguing phenomena, from wave amplification and mixing to exotic band structures, all stemming from the time-periodic modulation of optical properties. While these features have been well described classically, their quantum manifestation has remained elusive.

arxiv-2508-08560.title: Deep Finite Temperature Bootstrap
arxiv-2508-08560.creator: V. Niarchos, C. Papageorgakis, A. Stratoudakis, M. Woolley
arxiv-2508-08560.description: Abstract Abstract We introduce a novel method to bootstrap crossing equations in Conformal Field Theory and apply it to finite temperature theories on S 1 × ℝ d − 1 S^{1}\times{\mathbb{R}}^{d-1} . The proposed approach does not rely on positivity constraints and does not employ uncontrolled truncation schemes.

arxiv-2508-09512.title: On Complex Dimensions and Heat Content of Self-Similar Fractals
arxiv-2508-09512.creator: William E. Hoffer, Michel L. Lapidus
arxiv-2508-09512.description: Abstract . Complex fractal dimensions, defined as poles of appropriate fractal zeta functions, describe the geometric oscillations in fractal sets. In this work, we show that the same possible complex dimensions in the geometric setting also govern the asymptotics of the heat content on self-similar fractals.

pmc-12621102.title: The role of plant cell walls in pest resistance: current insights and future perspectives
pmc-12621102.creator: Marta Marina Perez-Alonso, Lucia Talavera-Mateo, Dairon Ojeda-Martinez, Laura Barcenilla-Valcárcel, Álvaro Montesinos, Alejandro Garcia, Carlos Frey, Marta Boter, Manuel Martinez, Isabel Diaz, M Estrella Santamaria
pmc-12621102.description: Significant strides have been made by researchers aiming to understand the crucial role of the plant cell wall (PCW) in defending against pathogens. Numerous reviews have synthesized findings on plant–pathogen interactions, shedding light on the role of the PCW in defence, the generation of cell wall damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs), perception, and signalling response.

pmc-12625887.title: Hypothyroidism in spontaneous coronary artery dissection: presentation, clinical and angiographic findings, management and outcomes
pmc-12625887.creator: Santiago J Camacho Freire, Marcos Garcia-Guimaraes, Ricardo Sanz-Ruiz, Manel Sabaté Tenas, Fernando Macaya, Gerard Roura, Marcelo Jimenez, David del Val, Teresa Bastante, Maite Velázquez - Martin, Santiago Jimenez Valero, Antonio Enrique Gómez-Menchero, Fernando Alfonso
pmc-12625887.description: BackgroundHypothyroidism has been suggested as a predisposing and prognostic factor in patients with spontaneous coronary artery dissection (SCAD), but evidence in this regard is very limited.MethodsThis study sought to compare differences in clinical presentation, angiographic findings, management and outcomes between SCAD patients with (H-SCAD) and without (NH-SCAD) a history of hypothyroidism from the prospective nation-wide Spanish SCAD Registry.

pmc-12951805.title: A Case Report of Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy in an Obese Patient With Situs Inversus Totalis
pmc-12951805.creator: Shohei Maruta, Tetsuro Ohno, Masami Yamada, Chiaki Fukuda, Akira Maki
pmc-12951805.description: Situs inversus totalis (SIT) is a rare congenital condition characterized by a complete mirror-image arrangement of the visceral organs. We report a laparoscopic cholecystectomy performed on an obese patient with a body mass index (BMI) over 30 kg/m² and SIT. An 80-year-old female patient with SIT and a BMI of 30.1 kg/m² was diagnosed with cholecystolithiasis.

pmc-13124516.title: Longitudinal retinal microvascular changes and their association with white matter hyperintensities in neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder
pmc-13124516.creator: Yi Liu, Saichan Xu, Hao Lin, Xiaohong Lei, Yanping Li, Zhipeng Xu, Ruili Wei, Hui-Rong Jiang, Jianhui Mei
pmc-13124516.description: BackgroundNeuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) is an autoimmune astrocytopathy characterized by recurrent inflammatory attacks within the central nervous system. Beyond optic neuritis, diffuse retinal and cerebral alterations may occur. Optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) enables the non-invasive assessment of retinal microvasculature and may provide insight into longitudinal retinal changes and their association with cerebral white matter hyperintensities (WMHs).

pmc-13420573.title: An Electrocardiographic Artifact Mimicking Pacemaker Malfunction
pmc-13420573.creator: Anish S Shah, Marc C Engels, Klitos Konstantinidis, T Jared Bunch
pmc-13420573.description: Case SummaryA patient presents with symptomatic bradycardia and high-grade atrioventricular block and receives a dual-chamber pacemaker with left bundle branch area pacing lead. Post procedure, there is concern for dislodgement of the ventricular lead after an electrocardiogram shows a missing ventricular paced beat.

pmc-13449473.title: Landscape modeling as a surveillance strategy for Trypanosoma cruzi vectors in Brazil
pmc-13449473.creator: Felipe de Oliveira, Raphael Testai, Matheus Pinheiro Ferreira, Cleber Galvão, Diogo Souza Bezerra Rocha, Ana Maria Jansen, Samanta Cristina das Chagas Xavier
pmc-13449473.description: BackgroundThe transmission of Trypanosoma cruzi in nature is closely linked to the ecology of its vectors, the triatomine insects. Although the geographic distribution of these species is relatively well-known, understanding the characteristics that define their ecological niche and how human interventions alter these conditions remains limited.

pmc-13594739.title: A randomized crossover study of cardiologist reporting of severe aortic stenosis with/without assistance from artificial intelligence (AI)
pmc-13594739.creator: David Playford, Dane Brescacin, Chris Frampton, Naveed Younis, Geoff Strange
pmc-13594739.description: SummaryInaccurate echocardiographic diagnosis of severe aortic stenosis (AS) may be improved by AI. A randomised case-control fully-crossed, paired-reader, paired-case (MRMC) study evaluated the performance of AI in assisting cardiologist reporting of severe AS. 200 echos were independently adjudicated by expert cardiologists, 100 with severe AS (cases) and 100 without severe AS (controls).

uslaw-usc-t44-s306.title: 44 U.S.C. § 306 — Director of the Government Publishing Office: employment of skilled workmen; trial of skill
uslaw-usc-t44-s306.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t44-s306.description: United States Code, Title 44 (Public Printing And Documents); Chapter 3 (Government Publishing Office). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Director of the Government Publishing Office shall employ workmen who are thoroughly skilled in their respective branches of industry, as shown by trial of their skill under the direction of the Director.
